targets.failed_criterion_detail: TWO load-bearing criteria failed, of different types. C2 (D_randrank - D_comm at MATCHED rank) is the ONLY rank-matched contrast and the only one licensing an orientation reading: mean 0.03196 against a 0.05 floor, 0 of 3 seeds individually clearing, sd 0.01688. It fails all THREE of _paired_positive's sub-tests at once (mean<floor; mean<2*sd, i.e. 0.03196 < 0.03377; n_clear=0 < 2) on one noisy signal. Every per-seed value is nonetheless POSITIVE ([0.03724, 0.04949, 0.00916]), so the dedicated non-positive falsification predicate _c2_falsified returns False and no rank-explains-it falsification is licensed either. C4b (absolute complement/comm sensitivity ceiling) is an ABSOLUTE criterion: mean 0.84684 against a <=0.5 ceiling, 3 of 3 seeds above it.

four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: under-instrumented -- DOMINANT, but on ONE count, not two (revised after the Step 7c red-team refuted the second). The real defect: C2's predicate is a THREE-way conjunction (mean>=0.05 floor AND mean>=2*sd AND seed-majority) evaluated at n=3, with sd 0.01688 of the same order as the mean 0.03196, so all three clauses fail together on one noisy signal. C4b also failed (0.84684 against a <=0.5 ceiling, 3/3 seeds above), and the ceiling is genuinely the least externally-anchored threshold in the design -- but the fix is to ANCHOR IT, not to promote C4a. WITHDRAWN: the draft reading that C4a is 'the better-anchored statistic' that 'agrees with the claim'. The driver marks C4a retention_confounded and scored_as_conjunct false for a stated reason -- once the weights are in, a random subspace is no longer matched on RETENTION, so the margin is partly a retention difference. Quantified from the manifest's own raw component norms: the margin an isotropic Jacobian would produce from retention geometry ALONE is 0.348 / 0.267 / 0.365 against observed 0.548 / 0.555 / 0.342 -- a majority of the margin on two seeds, and on seed 44 geometry OVER-predicts, meaning the fitted subspace does slightly worse than an encoder with no routing structure at all. C4a is a recorded diagnostic with a named confound, not a better-anchored statistic.
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: coupled, and NOT rank-censored (revised after the Step 7c red-team). RRR_RANKS is range(1,33) = 1..dy, the whole mathematically meaningful range -- at rank dy the constraint is inactive and the fit IS unconstrained OLS, so the ladder CANNOT be extended further. selected_rank 32 on 3/3 seeds reflects a FLAT asymptote, not a truncated optimum: heldout r2 gains from rank 16 to 32 are 8.5e-5 / 1.1e-4 / 1.6e-4 and from 31 to 32 are ~3e-7 to 7e-7, and the smallest rank within 0.001 of the maximum is 8 / 10 / 10. The design's own pre-registered hazard was the OPPOSITE one (queue-entry STATED LIMITATIONS (b): C2's reachability degrades if CV selects a LOW rank), so selecting the highest rank put C2's reachability at its most favourable, not its worst. The substantive finding the rank curve DOES support: this interface has no low-rank bottleneck -- z_world is an almost perfectly linear readout of world_state at any rank >= 8 (worst-seed heldout r2 0.9971). That is what makes the biology's low-rank premise untestable AT rank = dy and testable at the parsimonious rank.
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: likely insufficient -- 3 seeds, seed-majority bar of 2, against contrasts whose per-seed spread is of the same order as the effect.

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: Population-to-population communication subspaces (Semedo, Zandvakili, Machens, Yu, Kohn 2019, V1->V2): a source population's activity reaches its target through a low-dimensional subspace that does not span the source's full task-informative variance, so a variable can be present in the source and absent from what the target receives.
dependencies: a trained sender whose latent carries the task variable
a consumer that actually reads the receiver input
enough data to estimate the subspace out of sample
biological_reference.divergence: Not a formal-definition substitute -- the REE operationalisation (cross-validated RRR from sender activity to the actual consumer input tensor) is the same estimator family used in the source neuroscience. The load-bearing translation gap is about RANK, and it is the opposite of an instrument defect: in cortex the communication subspace is strictly LOWER-rank than the receiver population, whereas here cross-validation saturates and selects rank = dy, where the RRR is unconstrained OLS. So the biological premise -- that a low-rank channel is what content must pass through -- is not instantiated at this interface, which is a finding about the substrate rather than about the probe.

learning_extracted: A three-way conjunctive pass predicate evaluated at n=3 has no power to separate a small real effect from noise -- but 'raise n' is NOT automatically the repair. Here only ONE of the three clauses responds to n: the across-seed sd is a population sd (ddof=0), not a standard error, so the 2*sd clause does not shrink; and SEED_MAJORITY is a FIXED constant 2, so raising n turns 'a majority of seeds' into 'any 2 seeds' and converts a conjunctive predicate into a near-disjunctive one. Raising n without re-specifying the majority clause proportionally is threshold-gaming dressed as a power fix.

A statistic computed against a null is not thereby better-anchored than an absolute one. C4a is arithmetically C4b_null - C4b_measured, but the fitted and random subspaces are NOT matched on retention, and retention geometry alone accounts for a majority of C4a's margin on two seeds and all of it on a third. When a driver marks a statistic retention_confounded and declines to score it, an autopsy that promotes it owes an argument against the stated confound -- not silence.

A selected rank sitting at the ladder ceiling does NOT imply the ceiling chose it. Read the cross-validation curve before concluding censoring: here it is flat to seven significant figures above rank ~10, so CV picked the argmax of a saturated asymptote. The finding that survives is more interesting than the artefact that did not -- this interface has no low-rank bottleneck at all, which is precisely why the biology's low-rank premise cannot be tested at rank = dy.

routing_detail.recommended_form: ALPHABETIC SUFFIX (V3-EXQ-1043a) -- same scientific question, instrument repair. NOT a new EXQ number.
required_changes: ANCHOR C4b's ABSOLUTE 0.5 CEILING from a measured reference, the way the readiness anchors already are against V3-EXQ-1008. Do NOT promote C4a to the scored conjunct: it is retention-confounded by the driver's own stated design decision, and retention geometry alone accounts for most of its margin (0.348/0.267/0.365 predicted vs 0.548/0.555/0.342 observed; seed 44 over-predicted). Keep C4a recorded as a diagnostic WITH its confound stated in the manifest prose, which is what the driver already does.

RE-ESTIMATE AND REPORT C2 AS A FUNCTION OF RANK, and read it at the PARSIMONIOUS rank (8-10, where heldout r2 is already within 0.001 of its maximum). The low-rank premise the biology supplies is not testable at rank = dy, where the RRR fit is unconstrained OLS; it is testable there. This REPLACES the withdrawn 'extend the ladder' item, which is mathematically impossible -- rank into a 32-dim receiver is bounded by 32 and the ladder already spans 1..32.

IF n IS RAISED, RE-SPECIFY SEED_MAJORITY PROPORTIONALLY in the pre-registration (it is a fixed constant 2, inherited from x1002). Otherwise the seed-majority clause becomes trivially satisfiable and the successor's PASS is partly an artefact of the seed count. Note also the honest expectation: at adequate n the likely outcome is a confidence interval EXCLUDING 0.05 -- i.e. H1 falsified rather than rescued. Raise n to settle the question, not to pass it.

GIVE C2 A WITHIN-RUN REFERENCE DISTRIBUTION -- refit the RRR on shuffled sender-receiver pairing to build a permutation null, so the orientation contrast is judged against the instrument's own noise rather than a hand-set 0.05 floor. This is the single change least dependent on any contested reading above.

live_hypotheses: H1-small-but-real: the orientation effect is real and positive but smaller than the pre-registered 0.05 floor; judged against a within-run null it is distinguishable from zero.

H2-no-orientation: the fitted communication subspace is not meaningfully different from a random subspace of the same rank at this interface; C2's positivity is noise and will not survive a permutation null.

H3-no-low-rank-bottleneck: the routing question as the biology poses it is not instantiated at this interface at all -- z_world is an almost perfectly linear readout of world_state at any rank >= 8, so at the CV-selected rank = dy the 'communication subspace' is unconstrained OLS and there is no low-rank channel to be routed through. C2 measured at the parsimonious rank is the test.

suggested_probes.sketch: Raise n with SEED_MAJORITY re-specified proportionally, and report a confidence interval on the C2 mean rather than a floor test. Declared null: the CI excludes 0.05 (H1 falsified, not rescued).

Permutation null on the RRR fit itself (refit on shuffled sender-receiver pairing) to give C2 a within-run reference distribution instead of a hand-set floor. Declared null: the observed C2 sits inside the permutation null.

Sweep C2 across ranks 1..32 and read it at the parsimonious rank (8-10, r2 within 0.001 of max), where the low-rank premise holds. Declared null: C2 is flat in rank, so rank is not what hid the orientation signal.
